verdict.rationale: The official README and AGENTS.md document an explicit `skills update` command. It can update all installed skills to their latest versions, a single skill by name, or several named skills (`npx skills update frontend-design web-design-guidelines`), so you get fixes without reinstalling. HN commenters said update paths were undocumented, but that is a complaint about documentation, which the shipped docs contradict, not a hands-on report that updating fails. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation that `skills update` works in practice, and documentation of how 'latest' is resolved (pinning or lockfile interaction) beyond brief command-table entries.
